dsDescriptionValue.value:
This dataset contains all data and scripts used for Blomsma, P., Skantze, G., & Swerts, M. (2022). Backchannel behavior influences the perceived personality of human and artificial communication partners. Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence, 42. 

This includes:
1.	The avatar stimuli (videos)
2.	Experiment results 
3.	Scripts for analysis of experiment results.

publicationCitation.value: Blomsma, P., Skantze, G., & Swerts, M. (2022). Backchannel behavior influences the perceived personality of human and artificial communication partners. Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence, 42.

fields.value: Method: Online Qualtrics Questionnaire. Universe: Stimuli are based on the behaviour of 14 participants in the O-cam paradigm, which are Tilburg University Students. Participants in both experiment are also Tilburg University Students. Additional documentation and metadata can be found in the file "Data Report.pdf"
